_comment: Developer panel for Binghatti Holding Limited, consumed by real-estate-engine.
One developer: 1051 Binghatti Developers FZE, the operating subsidiary named in the issuer's own accounts.
The DIFC vehicles (Binghatti Properties Investment 1-20, Argenti Properties Investments) are 100% owned and
consolidated and hold no DLD projects of their own; the branch entity 2709 holds none either (checked 18 Sep 2026).
Definition is the same developer_first_sales rule the Emaar panel uses, so the two are comparable.

definition._comment: Procedures and the home rule are dpi's issuer-data rule (ingest/issuer-data.ts). The repeat rule drops a later non-off-plan registration of a unit key first registered off-plan at the same price (0.5%); on 16 Sep 2026 that was 125 registrations, AED 0.34bn, median 492 days after the off-plan registration.

maturity._comment: A quarter is provisional if it is within the trailing N quarters of source_as_of (the current, partial quarter counts as the first), or if more than max_orphan_share of that quarter's registrations market-wide carry a project number we do not hold, so cannot be attributed to any developer. On 16 Sep 2026 mature quarters ran 0.06-0.13% orphans, 2025Q4 0.80%, 2026 2.2-2.8%. The orphan rule applies only within orphan_rule_lookback_quarters, where a gap can still close; an older quarter over the threshold is reported as an attribution gap instead (2023Q4: 1.8%, two projects no source lists any more).

developers.attribution_scope: direct — Binghatti Developers FZE, the operating subsidiary of the issuer
